title: Turtle dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- shell -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="28" ry="22" fill="#2e8b57"/>
  <!-- shell pattern -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="18" ry="13" fill="#3cb371"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="9" ry="6" fill="#2e8b57"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="42" x2="50" y2="49" stroke="#66cdaa" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="61" x2="50" y2="68" stroke="#66cdaa" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="32" y1="55" x2="40" y2="55" stroke="#66cdaa" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="60" y1="55" x2="68" y2="55" stroke="#66cdaa" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="26" r="12" fill="#6abf69"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx="45" cy="24" r="2.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="45.8" cy="23.2" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="24" r="2.5" fill="#1a1a2e"/>
  <circle cx="55.8" cy="23.2" r="0.8" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M46 30 Q50 34 54 30" stroke="#1a1a2e" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- left arm up -->
  <path d="M24 50 Q14 40 18 30" stroke="#6abf69" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- right arm up -->
  <path d="M76 50 Q86 40 82 30" stroke="#6abf69" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- left leg -->
  <path d="M36 74 Q30 86 28 90" stroke="#6abf69" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- right leg -->
  <path d="M64 74 Q70 86 72 90" stroke="#6abf69" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- left foot -->
  <ellipse cx="26" cy="91" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#6abf69"/>
  <!-- right foot -->
  <ellipse cx="74" cy="91" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#6abf69"/>

  <!-- music notes -->
  <g fill="#ffd700">
    <path d="M20 18 L20 10 L26 8 L26 16" stroke="none"/>
    <circle cx="18" cy="18" r="3"/>
    <rect x="25" y="8" width="2" height="10"/>
    
    <circle cx="78" cy="14" r="3"/>
    <rect x="81" y="4" width="2" height="10"/>
    <path d="M81 4 Q86 2 88 6" stroke="#ffd700" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>
  </g>
</svg>
